Wander

UI component that provides wandering/drifting animation behavior for UI elements.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
{
  "wander": {}
}

Description

The Wander component provides wandering and drifting animation behavior for UI elements. It adds subtle, organic movement to UI components, creating a more dynamic and visually engaging interface.

Wander parameters are configured through UI properties.
